title: 4 new things in your app!
intro: Your app got simpler. Four tabs at the bottom now: Today, Dances, Skills and Me. Your music is one tap away, and the games are always open.
mom: New for Mom: four tabs (Today · Dances · Skills · Me). Practice opens from Today, Play from a tile on Me. Class days ask nothing at home; reminders are off until she turns one on. 🎀 Events on Today needs no PIN; costs and hotels stay locked.

items.pitch: Two big buttons: your solo and your trio. Tap one and your music plays.
steps: Tap “My solo” or “My trio”. Your music starts.
Dance it to the end. That's one dance, and your count goes up.
Under the buttons: “📹 Videos” and “🧠 Memorize”.
“🎀 Events” under the card shows every comp and what to pack.

items.pitch: Tap a dance to open it. The 🎵 button plays its music.
steps: Tap Dances at the bottom. Your comp dances come first.
Tap 🎵 on a card and the music plays.
Tap the card: “🎵 Play music” and “🧠 Memorize” are on top.

items.n: A Skills tab and a skill of the month
items.pitch: Everything you're learning is on one tab. Pick one skill for this month.
steps: In “⭐ My skill this month”, pick the one you want.
“📷 My photos” keeps a Before and a Now picture.
“✏️ Name this page” lets you call the tab what you like.

items.n: Play and your own settings on Me
items.pitch: Play is one button on Me. Don't like your dancer or your pet? Put it away.
steps: Tap Me, then “Play”. All the games are there, always open.
At the bottom of Me, open “⚙️ My app”.
“👀 What's showing” puts your dancer or your pet away, or brings it back.
